annotation.title_clean: Human workers as physical AI data generators: A socio-technical governance model for sustainable manufacturing transformation
annotation.title_en: Human workers as physical AI data generators: A socio-technical governance model for sustainable manufacturing transformation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Saptadi, S.; Budiawan, W.; Aryasa, I.G.I.
annotation.venue: World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews
annotation.summary_en: PRISMA-guided review of 187 sources proposing a Socio-Technical Physical AI Data Governance Framework that treats manual manufacturing workers as Physical AI data generators. It combines Fuzzy BWM, Bayesian networks and Fuzzy FMEA to balance productivity, ergonomics and surveillance perception. The framework is conceptual and needs empirical validation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reframes workers as intentional Physical AI Data Generators rather than passive monitoring subjects.
Identifies a governance vacuum for continuous physical monitoring and tacit-knowledge extraction.
Proposes an integrated Fuzzy BWM, Bayesian network and Fuzzy FMEA decision engine.
Notes the EU AI Act classifies worker monitoring as high-risk and bans workplace emotion recognition.
Warns of 'data colonies' in developing economies and an SME governance divide.
